templates.name: 2D Platformer
templates.description: A side-scrolling platformer from the first jump to a short playable demo: movement with coyote time, a tilemap level, enemies, pickups, a menu and a build.
templates.author: Gamedev Dashboard

templates.name: 3D Third Person
templates.description: A third-person 3D game: camera-relative movement with a CharacterController, an orbit camera with Cinemachine 3, a blocked-out level, models from Blender and simple enemies.
templates.author: Gamedev Dashboard

templates.name: Game Jam (48 hours)
templates.description: A tight plan for a 48-hour jam: idea in the first hour, playable core after 12 hours, content and polish after that, upload with time to spare.
templates.author: Gamedev Dashboard

templates.name: Pixel Art Workflow
templates.description: From Krita to Unity without blurry sprites: canvas sizes, a palette, layers as sprites, pixels per unit and the Pixel Perfect Camera.
templates.author: Gamedev Dashboard

templates.name: Top-Down RPG
templates.description: A small top-down adventure: walking in 8 directions, a village and a dungeon, NPC talk, enemies that chase, items and saving.
templates.author: Gamedev Dashboard
